data.name: CAAAHR
data.detailed_description:
CAAAHR is a chaotic coop game where two players control one very questionable car using teamwork, timing, and increasingly concerning vocal noises.

One player uses their voice to accelerate the car. The louder you are, the faster it goes. The other player steers the car through dangerous tracks, obstacle courses, jumps, traps, and other terrible ideas. They also need to use short sounds and noises to trigger boosts, jumps, and special abilities at the right moment.

Communication is key. Unfortunately, screaming also works.

You can play together online, locally, or even alone if you feel like arguing with yourself instead of a friend. Either way, by the end of the journey, you will probably lose your voice. Possibly also your friendship. Embrace the noise.

  • Voice-Based Coop Racing Chaos
    Scream to accelerate. Make noises to jump, boost, and survive.

  • Local & Online Coop
    Destroy friendships from anywhere in the world. Singleplayer is also supported for brave solo drivers.

  • Perfect for Streamers & Friend Groups
    Loud, chaotic, and guaranteed to create clips nobody can explain out of context.

  • Online Leaderboards
    Compete with other duos worldwide and prove your friendship is slightly more functional.

  • Built for Speedrunners
    Includes an ingame timer and optional shortcuts for people who enjoy suffering efficiently.

  • Unlock Skins & Achievements
    Find cosmetics and rewards hidden throughout the journey.

  • One Giant Handcrafted Level
    Featuring dangerous obstacles, optional checkpoints, and many opportunities to panic.

  • Fully Rebindable Controls
    Because every keyboard deserves a chance to recover differently.

Hey! I'm Mateo, a 23-year-old solo game developer from Germany.

In July 2025, I released my first coop rage game, Paddle Paddle Paddle, which somehow went viral and damaged an alarming number of friendships. Now I'm back with my second chaotic coop experience: CAAAHR

This time, I wanted to combine challenging coop gameplay with voice controls, loud communication, and complete panic. I truly hope you enjoy it. Your neighbors probably won't.

data.short_description: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

English*, German, French, Spanish - Spain, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian
*languages with full audio support
